scope: Read-only patch and connected production lifecycle review; no tests, builds, or source edits
drag: Process::try_write_input maps a full record queue to WouldBlock and rolls back input_bytes; write_input maps WouldBlock to byte-budget text. The patch changes only the stale expected message and retains drag-view and zero-byte rollback assertions.
native_stream: Slow initial attach snapshot is consumed before the20MiB output burst. Replayable queue overflow sets needs_snapshot. Healthy DONE delivery proves the owner has already applied the full burst before slow consumption begins. flush_native sends the replacement only once delivery_bytes==0 and no prior snapshot is pending; the first replacement therefore contains final READYDONE. receive asserts on disconnection and has a30-second deadline. The patch keeps bounded backlog1..256, recovered PID/text, exact healthy bytes/zeros/sequence, PTY liveness and reconnect assertions.
correction: The initial review missed that cumulative queued receives can exceed the instantaneous channel capacity. Runtime validation observed257, invalidating the1..256 cumulative assertion. Root replaced the counter with existing snapshot(&slow), retaining authoritative READYDONE/PID/healthy/PTTY/reconnect checks. Exact instantaneous bounds are covered separately by critical_backlog_and_final_barriers_share_finite_budgets and native_byte_backlog_recovers_without_blocking_healthy_client. Initial native-stream patch is preserved as runtime-stale-tests-prep/native-stream-initial.patch; runtime-qa-amend-results.json records final validated source.
